def: to keep still (intransitively), i.e. refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech
kjv: cease, hold peace, be quiet, rest

occurrences.text: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
